title: Tech4tree plant
description:
A model inspired by @koopavonkuerbis, it is meant to represent a houseplant.

Fan-made resource pack inspired by existing designs. Not affiliated with Mojang or the original creators.
body:
DE: Tutorial für die Tech4Tree Zimmerpflanze..

1. Erhalte einen Eichenholzsetzling
2. Benenne diesen mithilfe eines Ambosses in "Tech4Tree" um.
3. [Optional] Platziere diesen in einen Rahmen (Tipp: bei unsichtbaren Rahmen sieht es besser aus)
Unsichtbarer Rahmen Command: /give @s item_frame[entity_data={id:"minecraft:item_frame",Invisible:1b}]

EN: Tech4Tree Houseplant Tutorial

1. Get an oak sapling
2. Rename it using an anvil to "Tech4Tree"
3. [Optional] Place it in an item frame (Tip: invisible item frames look cleaner)
Invisible Item Frame Command: /give @s item_frame[entity_data={id:"minecraft:item_frame",Invisible:1b}]
